breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly stated to set the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface. The agent removed this erroneous instruction and instead correctly specified how to calculate the torsional shear stress (τ = T * c / J) and then use that value in the subsequent plane stress calculation (τxy = τ). This aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
